scenes.title: FEMM Agent Suite
lines: AI agents that drive FEMM 5, and prove the answers are right.

scenes.title: The problem
lines: Finite element tools were built for clicks.
FEMM 5 runs headless on every desktop platform and takes scripts over TCP.
But an agent still needs a validated layer: one that catches mistakes, checks the physics, and records what it did.

scenes.title: Architecture
lines: The suite is an MCP server.
It launches headless FEMM instances and speaks their TCP protocol directly.

lines.say: Eighty-eight tools in twelve groups, from geometry and materials to experiments, health checks and reports.
lines.show: 88 tools in 12 groups, from geometry and materials to experiments, health checks and reports.

scenes.title: An agent at work

lines.say: Ask for a twelve-slot, four-pole surface magnet motor.
lines.show: Ask for a 12-slot, 4-pole surface magnet motor.

lines: The agent builds it, solves in a fraction of a second, and runs cogging two independent ways.

lines.say: Then it proves the torque: one point four one five newton metres simulated, against one point four two eight from the d q formula.
lines.show: Then it proves the torque: 1.415 N·m simulated, against 1.428 N·m from the dq formula.

scenes.title: Validated against theory
lines: Every claim is benchmarked against theory.

lines.say: The solenoid self-test is within point seven percent. Cogging methods agree to point three.
lines.show: The solenoid self-test is within 0.7 %. Cogging methods agree to 0.3 %.

lines.say: A C resistance matches Bessel, and the electrostatic, thermal and current flow cases sit within one percent.
lines.show: AC resistance matches Bessel, and the electrostatic, thermal and current-flow cases sit within 1 %.

scenes.title: Skills
lines: Eleven Claude skills are the operating manual, from a router to machine design and troubleshooting.

scenes.title: Install
lines: Install with one script, or as a Claude Code plugin.
Then just ask: run the FEMM self-test.
